_meta.purpose: Manually curated layout-guideline facts per IC family, cited to datasheet section/page. Used by design_judgments.py to cross-check toolchain geometry against vendor guidance for ANY component with a matching profile — not limited to one part number.
_meta.how_to_extend: Add a new object under 'profiles'. 'match' is a regex tested against footprint Value AND footprint name (case-insensitive, first match wins by list order). Each 'facts' entry should cite doc + section/page so replies can show provenance. Mark 'verified' false until a human confirms against the current datasheet revision.

profiles.doc: TI SLVSF61 (TPS56637) datasheet + TI PowerPAD layout app notes

facts.guideline: Keep the SW-node copper as small/short as practical; use a wide-but-short shape only large enough to carry rated current, not a large flood.
Route FB away from SW node and inductor; keep short and reference a quiet ground (GNDA) rather than the power SW loop.
Place the BOOT capacitor (typ. 2.2–10 nF) as close as possible to the BOOT and SW pins to minimize bootstrap loop inductance.
Place high-frequency input capacitor directly at VIN/PGND pins; minimize the VIN-cap-GND loop area.
Use multiple thermal vias under the exposed pad to sink heat to inner/bottom GND planes.

facts.topic: VIN ceramic C after DC bias
facts.guideline: Keep enough ceramic CIN at the operating VIN after Class-II DC-bias loss (typical recommendation 10 uF ceramic).

facts.topic: VOUT ceramic C after DC bias
facts.guideline: Output ceramic capacitance after DC bias should stay above the recommended minimum (typically 22 uF class).

profiles.doc: Silergy SY8843 datasheet, Layout Consideration section

facts.guideline: Keep LX node trace/pour short and direct between IC and inductor; avoid routing other signals near/under it.
Place input bypass capacitor as close as possible to VIN and GND pins.
Keep the feedback trace away from the LX switching node and inductor; route on a quiet layer if possible.

facts.topic: VIN ceramic C after DC bias
facts.guideline: Place ceramic CIN at VIN; count capacitance after DC-bias derating, not the marked uF. Typical minimum 10 uF effective.

facts.topic: VOUT ceramic C after DC bias
facts.guideline: Output ceramic after DC-bias derating should meet the recommended COUT (typically 22 uF class).
